text:
ben_support: FYI — escalated from Acme support. After this morning's canary (around 12:10 UTC) customers are seeing code fences not closed and stray tokens appended to markdown outputs. Customer pasted a minimal repro below.

ben_support: (customer paste)

User prompt:

Please wrap the SQL in a fenced code block:

```sql
SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE active = true;
```

API response we returned:

Here you go:

```sql
SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE active = true;

// execution note: results truncated


<|endofoutput|>

(we trimmed repeated whitespace/escapes for privacy)

ben_support: customers see two problems: 1) missing closing ``` in many outputs, 2) extra control tokens like `<|endofoutput|>` or `\u0000`-style junk appended to the end of the message. They started after the canary rolled.

elaine_eng: thanks. can you paste the exact request body and model id & request id? also which customer org?

ben_support: request id: rq_0a9f5c, model: redwood-instruct-v1.3-canary, org: AcmeCorp. request body:

POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-instruct-v1.3-canary",
  "prompt": "Please wrap the SQL in a fenced code block:\n\nSELECT id, email FROM users WHERE active = true;",
  "max_tokens": 200,
  "temperature": 0.0
}

ben_support: they also included the raw bytes we returned — saw some embedded \u0000 bytes and an `<|endofoutput|>` token at EOF.

ryan_infra: @deploy-bot can you confirm what changed in the canary? any tokenizer or serve changes?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-17T12:05Z -> commit f2b7c9a: "perf: tokenizer lookup cache + unify decode path". Config: enable_new_decode=true for canary traffic.

ryan_infra: that decode path change is suspicious. it moved stop-sequence handling earlier in the pipeline to rely on in-memory token flags. if the tokenizer cache returned different token boundaries, the post-decode stop-trim could be skipped.

maya_product: we saw a couple internal evals fail earlier but thought they were noise. we need a quick mitigation for customers. options: pin affected customers to stable model variant, disable canary flag, or force post-processing to remove trailing control tokens.

elaine_eng: immediate steps: 1) roll affected orgs to redwood-instruct-v1.3-stable (hotfix pin), 2) roll back canary flag (disable enable_new_decode) if we see >1% error rate, 3) eng-ml owns root cause and hotfix.

ryan_infra: repro plan for eng-ml: run generation with same prompt + canary flags enabled, compare tokenized sequences and final decoded string. check for missing trailing backticks and presence of any non-printable bytes. I'll attach tokenizer diffs and logs.

ben_support: Acme wants an ETA and asked if their customers' docs will be corrupted in their app. asked for a temporary workaround — we'll suggest they sanitize outputs client-side for code fences until we fix.

maya_product: assign to eng-ml, priority P1 for customer-impacting formatting regressions. I'll open a ticket and ping the oncall.

elaine_eng: @ryan_infra @maya_product please include request ids and sample outputs in the ticket. ben, keep Acme updated with rollback timeline. :eyes:

ben_support: ack. I'll update the customer and post back once we have rollback confirmed. :sad:
